MCC.Title: Mausritter Damage Helper
MCC.Settings.AutoCritical.Name: Resolve critical damage automatically
MCC.Settings.AutoCritical.Hint: When a pending STR save fails, adds Injured and posts the consequences.
MCC.Settings.ApplyArmor.Name: Apply armor
MCC.Settings.ApplyArmor.Hint: Core rule: armor reduces incoming damage before HP/STR.
MCC.Settings.PromptStrengthSave.Name: Prompt STR save
MCC.Settings.PromptStrengthSave.Hint: When damage reaches STR, creates a warning to resolve critical damage.
MCC.Settings.UseGrit.Name: Variant: GRIT absorbs damage
MCC.Settings.UseGrit.Hint: Optional rule for tables using GRIT as a buffer before HP. Off by default to preserve core Mausritter.
MCC.Settings.WdipLabels.Name: We Deal in Pips labels
MCC.Settings.WdipLabels.Hint: Uses labels compatible with the WDIP layer when active.
MCC.Settings.AutoUsage.Name: Spend uses automatically
MCC.Settings.AutoUsage.Hint: When a weapon, spell, or item with uses is used from an actor sheet, automatically marks one usage pip.
MCC.NoTargets: Target at least one token before applying damage.
MCC.NoPermission: You do not have permission to modify {name}.
MCC.NoActor: The targeted token has no actor.
MCC.Critical: {name} took STR damage. Make a STR save or suffer critical damage.
MCC.CriticalPending: {name}: pending STR save for critical damage.
MCC.CriticalSuccess: {name} succeeds on the STR save and can keep fighting.
MCC.CriticalFailure: {name} fails the STR save: they take the Injured condition and are incapacitated until tended to by an ally and able to take a short rest. If left untended for 6 exploration turns, they die.
MCC.ItemLossReminder: The Injured condition occupies space as a condition card; if there is no inventory space, decide which item must be dropped or lost to make room.
MCC.InjuredDesc: Disadvantage on STR and DEX saves.
MCC.UsageError: Could not spend a use of {name}. Check the console for details.
